# IsEmptyFunctionUsage

<Badge type="info" text="info" /> <Badge type="tip" text="on by default" /> <Badge type="tip" text="quick-fix" />

Group: [Code style](/rules/#code-style) · PhpStorm name: `IsEmptyFunctionUsageInspection`

`empty()` treats many unrelated values (`0`, `'0'`, `''`, `[]`, `null`,
`false`) as "empty". When the argument's type is known, a precise check is
clearer: `count(...) === 0` for countables, `... === null` for nullable
scalars/objects. Optionally, any other `empty()` use can be flagged.

## Example

All four options on, regular style:

::: code-group

```php{5,6,7,18,19,20,21,22,23,24,42} [Before]
<?php

function tally(array $rows, \SplObjectStorage $seen)
{
    if (empty($rows)) {}
    if (!empty($seen)) {}
    if (empty(($rows))) {}
}

/**
 * @param float|null $ratio
 * @param true|null  $flag
 * @param string|null $label
 */
function probe($ratio, $flag, $label, ?\DateTime $when, \stdClass $box, $map)
{
    return [
        empty($ratio),
        !empty($flag),
        empty($when),
        empty($box),
        empty($label),
        !empty($label),
        empty(0),
        empty($map['key']),
    ];
}

class Node
{
    /** @var Node|null */
    public $next;
    /** @var string */
    public $name;
}

function walk(Node $n)
{
    return [
        empty($n->next),
        empty($n->next->next),
        empty($n->name),
    ];
}
```

```php [After fix]
<?php

function tally(array $rows, \SplObjectStorage $seen)
{
    if (count($rows) === 0) {}
    if (count($seen) !== 0) {}
    if (count($rows) === 0) {}
}

/**
 * @param float|null $ratio
 * @param true|null  $flag
 * @param string|null $label
 */
function probe($ratio, $flag, $label, ?\DateTime $when, \stdClass $box, $map)
{
    return [
        $ratio === null,
        $flag !== null,
        $when === null,
        $box === null,
        empty($label),
        !empty($label),
        empty(0),
        empty($map['key']),
    ];
}

class Node
{
    /** @var Node|null */
    public $next;
    /** @var string */
    public $name;
}

function walk(Node $n)
{
    return [
        empty($n->next),
        empty($n->next->next),
        empty($n->name),
    ];
}
```

:::

## Options

| Option | Type | Default | Effect |
|---|---|---|---|
| REPORT_EMPTY_USAGE | bool | false | Enables the generic report D3. |
| SUGGEST_TO_USE_COUNT_CHECK | bool | false | Enables D1 (count comparison for arrays/Countable). |
| SUGGEST_TO_USE_NULL_COMPARISON | bool | true | Enables D2 (null comparison) as a whole. |
| SUGGEST_NULL_COMPARISON_FOR_SCALARS | bool | true | Enables D2a (nullable int/float/bool/resource); D2b (objects) only needs the previous option. |

Global setting: comparison style (`regular` default / `yoda`) selects the
operand order of F1/F2.

## Configure

In [`custos.json`](/guide/configuration):

```json
{
  "rules": {
    "IsEmptyFunctionUsage": {
      "enabled": false,
      "options": {
        "REPORT_EMPTY_USAGE": false,
        "SUGGEST_TO_USE_COUNT_CHECK": false,
        "SUGGEST_TO_USE_NULL_COMPARISON": true,
        "SUGGEST_NULL_COMPARISON_FOR_SCALARS": true
      }
    }
  }
}
```

## Suppress

Before the statement or declaration (or the first statement of the file), either of:

```php
// @custos-ignore IsEmptyFunctionUsage

/**
 * @noinspection IsEmptyFunctionUsageInspection
 */
```
